patterns.what_worked: Decoupled the tick from the ranged bar without a new frame: the hunter hook rides bars.lua's never-hidden per-hand anchor frame, the widgets parent to it with every anchor/width still keyed to the bar, and a visibility+script dedupe keeps exactly one tick source per frame. Red-first M1 (revert to ranged-tick-only) killed the hidden-bar cast/helper/badge pins; M2 (both sources) killed the no-double-tick pin.
patterns.what_was_hard: The obvious clean fix - a dedicated hunter-owned driver frame - adds a 7th build-time hunter frame and fails the frame census pinned in tests/bars_state.lua:1059, a file outside this lane's write scope (reproduced: got 21, want 20). The anchor-frame host is the scope-compliant equivalent; the report files the census hoist as an owner follow-up. A show-rule gate keyed on hand_show_condition_met hid the whole set in the bars_state fixture (which does not model in-combat/target state), so the gate evaluates the show rule only while the bar frame is not visible.
patterns.skill_gap: None blocking. Hidden-frame rendering/OnUpdate semantics remain client-only (UNVERIFIED offline, as the audit noted).
